data.one_liner: Hides sensitive content when switching away from the app.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package providing a widget that listens to AppLifecycle states to swap sensitive content with public content when the app goes into the background or previews. It protects information from being exposed in app switchers.
use_when: You need to hide sensitive financial or personal data in the device task switcher
You want a simple widget-level approach to handle app background previews
avoid_when: You need native OS-level secure window flags rather than a Flutter widget swap
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and macOS
weaknesses: Relies on widget-level app lifecycle state changes rather than native window flags
